acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of the terms of service
acceptance.body: Welcome to the RuoYi-FastAPI mobile framework (the Product). RuoYi-FastAPI owns and operates the Product. Read this agreement carefully before use. By clicking Agree or using the services, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted all terms of this agreement.

security.title: 2. Accounts and security
security.body: Provide true, accurate, current and complete personal information when registering. You are responsible for protecting your account and password and for all activities under your account. Notify us immediately if you discover unauthorized use.

conduct.title: 3. User conduct
conduct.body: You must comply with applicable laws and regulations when using the Product. Do not use it for unlawful activities, including publishing false information, infringing intellectual property, distributing obscene content or conducting cyberattacks.

changes.title: 4. Changes, interruptions and termination of services
changes.body: Due to the nature of network services, we may change, interrupt or terminate some or all services at any time. We will try to announce interruptions caused by maintenance or network failures in advance, but accept no liability for resulting losses.

intellectualProperty.title: 5. Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: All content in the Product, including text, images, audio, video and software code, belongs to RuoYi-FastAPI or the respective rights holders. Unauthorized use, copying, modification or distribution is prohibited.

disclaimer.title: 6. Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: The Product is provided as is, without express or implied warranties. We accept no liability for interruptions or data loss caused by force majeure, cyberattacks or system instability.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: RuoYi-FastAPI takes your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information. Read it carefully before using the Product.

collection.title: 1. Collection and use of personal information
collection.body: To provide better services, we may collect the following information:
collection.account: • Account information: when you register or sign in, we collect your username, password, mobile number and related information.
collection.device: • Device information: to keep your account secure and improve services, we collect your device model, operating system version and unique device identifier.
collection.log: • Log information: we automatically collect operation logs, IP addresses and access times when you use the Product.

sharing.title: 2. Sharing, transfer and disclosure of personal information
sharing.body: We do not share, transfer or publicly disclose your personal information to third parties, except:
sharing.consent: • With your explicit authorization or consent;
sharing.law: • As required by laws, regulations or judicial authorities;
sharing.publicInterest: • To protect national security, public safety or substantial public interests.

protection.title: 3. Protection of personal information
protection.body: We use measures including encryption, access controls and security audits to protect your information. We strive to prevent unauthorized access, alteration or disclosure.

rights.title: 4. Your rights
rights.body: You may access, correct or delete your personal information and close your account. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details in the Contact us section.

updates.title: 5. Updates to this policy
updates.body: We may update this policy as laws or our business change. Updates will be published in the Product, and we will notify you appropriately before they take effect.

contact.title: 6. Contact us
contact.body: For questions or suggestions about this policy, please contact us:
